title: Les règles de sécurité
oneGoal: Students learn the basic safety rules for science class

mindsOn.activity: Safety symbol circle time with gestures
mindsOn.decisionPoint: If students are restless → add movement; If focused → continue with symbols

action.decisionPoint: If students struggle with French → use more gestures; If confident → add vocabulary practice

consolidation.activity: Safety rule demonstration and commitment
assessmentChecklist: States one safety rule in French
consolidation.decisionPoint: If students need more practice → extend to next lesson

emergencyBackup: Safety song with actions and picture book
safetyNote: Establish clear stop signal and practice it multiple times

title: Mes yeux observent
oneGoal: Students learn to observe safely with their eyes only

mindsOn.activity: Eye observation game with mystery box
mindsOn.decisionPoint: If students want to touch → remind safety rules; If following rules → add more objects

action.decisionPoint: If students forgetting safety → pause for reminder; If engaged → extend observation time

consolidation.activity: Share one observation drawing and describe
consolidation.decisionPoint: If vocabulary challenging → focus on gestures and simple words

emergencyBackup: Look and find game with classroom objects
safetyNote: Hands behind back rule when observing with eyes only

title: Toucher en sécurité
oneGoal: Students learn safe touching rules and gentle exploration

mindsOn.activity: Gentle touch practice with stuffed animals
mindsOn.decisionPoint: If too rough → model gentleness more; If gentle → introduce texture vocabulary

action.decisionPoint: If students rushing → slow down practice; If ready → add describing textures

consolidation.activity: Touch and describe circle sharing
consolidation.decisionPoint: If need more practice → repeat with different textures

emergencyBackup: Texture guessing game with simple objects
safetyNote: Always ask permission before touching any object or material

title: Écouter les sons
oneGoal: Students use their ears safely to explore sounds

mindsOn.activity: Silent listening circle with nature sounds
mindsOn.decisionPoint: If too noisy → establish quiet signal; If focused → add more sounds

action.decisionPoint: If volume too high → establish sound limits; If engaged → create sound patterns

consolidation.activity: Favorite sound sharing and imitation
consolidation.decisionPoint: If too excited → calm with quiet sounds

emergencyBackup: Sound story with actions and simple instruments
safetyNote: Keep all sounds at safe volume levels for young ears

title: Sentir avec prudence
oneGoal: Students learn safe smelling techniques with appropriate materials

mindsOn.activity: Safe smelling demonstration with teacher modeling
mindsOn.decisionPoint: If students want to smell immediately → practice technique first; If patient → continue modeling

action.decisionPoint: If allergies appear → remove scent immediately; If comfortable → add scent vocabulary

consolidation.activity: Favorite smell sharing with safe technique demo
consolidation.decisionPoint: If technique needs work → practice more before moving on

emergencyBackup: Smell memory game with common safe scents
safetyNote: Never smell unknown substances - only teacher-approved safe materials

title: Objets sécuritaires
oneGoal: Students identify and safely manipulate classroom science materials

mindsOn.activity: Safe vs unsafe sorting with material cards
mindsOn.decisionPoint: If unsure about safety → discuss more examples; If confident → introduce real materials

action.decisionPoint: If rough handling → pause for gentle reminder; If careful → add more complex materials

consolidation.activity: Demonstrate proper care of one science tool
consolidation.decisionPoint: If need more practice → repeat with different materials

emergencyBackup: Material matching game with pictures and real objects
safetyNote: Only touch materials after teacher permission and demonstration

title: Observer ensemble
oneGoal: Students work together to observe materials using all senses safely

mindsOn.activity: Partner observation practice with simple objects
mindsOn.decisionPoint: If partners struggling → model turn-taking; If working well → add communication prompts

action.decisionPoint: If conflicts arise → practice sharing rules; If collaborating well → add vocabulary challenges

consolidation.activity: Team presentation of one shared observation
consolidation.decisionPoint: If presentations too long → set time limits

emergencyBackup: Whole class observation of one interesting object
safetyNote: Wait for your turn and respect your partner's observations

title: Vivant ou non-vivant?
oneGoal: Students begin to distinguish between living and non-living things safely

mindsOn.activity: Living things movement game and discussion
mindsOn.decisionPoint: If concept confusing → use more concrete examples; If understanding → add edge cases

activities: Safe observation of classroom plants (~9 min)
action.decisionPoint: If sorting difficult → focus on clear examples; If confident → introduce borderline cases

consolidation.activity: Explain one living and one non-living thing choice
consolidation.decisionPoint: If explanations unclear → provide sentence starters

emergencyBackup: Living things picture book with simple sorting
safetyNote: Be extra gentle with all living things - they can be hurt

title: Les plantes autour de nous
oneGoal: Students safely observe and identify basic plant characteristics

mindsOn.activity: Plant part identification with real plants
mindsOn.decisionPoint: If vocabulary challenging → focus on fewer parts; If learning quickly → add functions

activities: Plant part drawing and labeling (~9 min)
action.decisionPoint: If too rough with plants → reinforce gentleness; If careful → explore more plant varieties

consolidation.activity: Show and name plant parts on classroom plant
consolidation.decisionPoint: If need more practice → use additional plants next lesson

emergencyBackup: Plant part matching game with pictures and real examples
safetyNote: Plants are living - touch only with permission and be very gentle

title: Les animaux et nous
oneGoal: Students safely observe and discuss animal characteristics including humans

mindsOn.activity: Animal movement imitation and characteristic guessing
mindsOn.decisionPoint: If too excited → calm with quieter animals; If focused → add characteristic discussion

action.decisionPoint: If self-comparison difficult → use more concrete examples; If understanding → add similarities discussion

consolidation.activity: Share one way humans are like other animals
consolidation.decisionPoint: If connections unclear → provide more guided examples

emergencyBackup: Animal sounds and movement game with characteristic discussion
safetyNote: Only observe real animals from safe distance with adult supervision

title: Comparer les vivants
oneGoal: Students compare characteristics between plants, animals, and humans safely

mindsOn.activity: Three-way comparison sorting with living things
mindsOn.decisionPoint: If sorting confusing → focus on obvious differences; If confident → add subtle comparisons

activities: Venn diagram creation with pictures (~9 min)
action.decisionPoint: If Venn diagram difficult → use simpler sorting; If successful → add more categories

consolidation.activity: Explain one similarity and one difference between groups
consolidation.decisionPoint: If vocabulary challenging → accept gestures and simple words

emergencyBackup: Simple comparison game with obvious examples
safetyNote: Remember gentle observation rules when comparing living things

title: Scientifiques sécuritaires
oneGoal: Students demonstrate all safety skills while exploring like scientists

mindsOn.activity: Scientist badge ceremony and safety pledge
mindsOn.decisionPoint: If not ready for independence → review safety rules; If confident → begin exploration

action.decisionPoint: If safety issues → pause and review; If exploring well → extend exploration time

consolidation.activity: Scientist reflection and safety demonstration
consolidation.decisionPoint: If not demonstrating mastery → plan additional practice

emergencyBackup: Guided science exploration with strong teacher support
safetyNote: Scientists always put safety first in everything they do

title: Nos découvertes
oneGoal: Students share and explain their observations using proper science vocabulary

mindsOn.activity: Discovery show-and-tell preparation with vocabulary cards
mindsOn.decisionPoint: If vocabulary overwhelming → focus on key words; If confident → encourage elaboration

action.decisionPoint: If presentations too long → set time limits; If engaged → allow more sharing time

consolidation.activity: Celebration of learning with vocabulary review
consolidation.decisionPoint: If vocabulary needs work → plan more practice activities

emergencyBackup: Simple discovery sharing circle with picture supports
safetyNote: Handle all discovery items with the same safety rules we learned

title: Révision complète
oneGoal: Students demonstrate mastery of all safety rules and observation skills

mindsOn.activity: Science skills assessment station setup and preview
mindsOn.decisionPoint: If anxious about assessment → reassure it's celebration; If confident → explain station expectations

action.decisionPoint: If struggling with skills → note for additional support; If mastering → celebrate achievements

consolidation.activity: Individual conference and goal setting for extensions
consolidation.decisionPoint: If additional practice needed → plan review sessions

emergencyBackup: Science skills review game with gentle assessment
safetyNote: Show your best safety skills - you've learned so much!

title: Jardin d'exploration
oneGoal: Students apply safety skills while exploring outdoor living things

mindsOn.activity: Outdoor safety rules discussion and preparation
mindsOn.decisionPoint: If weather inappropriate → use window observations; If good conditions → proceed outdoors

action.decisionPoint: If students too excited → pause for safety reminders; If focused → extend exploration time

consolidation.activity: Share outdoor discoveries and compare to indoor learning
consolidation.decisionPoint: If too stimulated by outdoor experience → use calming activities

emergencyBackup: Indoor nature observation with window view and potted plants
safetyNote: Outdoor safety is even more important - stay with the group and ask before touching anything

title: Créer des collections
oneGoal: Students safely collect and organize non-living natural materials

mindsOn.activity: Collection examples exploration and sorting ideas
mindsOn.decisionPoint: If overwhelmed by choices → suggest simple categories; If excited → encourage creative sorting

action.decisionPoint: If collecting unsafe items → review safety rules; If good choices → encourage organization creativity

consolidation.activity: Present collection organization and explain sorting choices
consolidation.decisionPoint: If presentations too complex → focus on simple explanations

emergencyBackup: Classroom material collection and sorting activity
safetyNote: Only collect non-living things and always check with teacher first

title: Art scientifique
oneGoal: Students create art representations of their scientific observations

mindsOn.activity: Scientific art examples and technique demonstration
mindsOn.decisionPoint: If focused on accuracy → encourage creativity too; If too creative → remind of scientific purpose

activities: Art creation with scientific focus (~9 min)
Add scientific labels and descriptions (~9 min)
action.decisionPoint: If rushing through art → slow down for observation; If too detailed → encourage completion

consolidation.activity: Art gallery walk with scientific explanations
consolidation.decisionPoint: If explanations too long → set time limits for sharing

emergencyBackup: Simple scientific drawing with basic labeling
safetyNote: Use art materials safely and continue gentle observation of subjects

title: Histoires de science
oneGoal: Students tell stories about their scientific discoveries and observations

mindsOn.activity: Science story examples and story elements discussion
mindsOn.decisionPoint: If stories too complex → focus on simple structure; If understanding → encourage creativity

activities: Plan science story with safety focus (~9 min)
Create story with pictures or props (~9 min)
action.decisionPoint: If stories getting unrealistic → guide back to science accuracy; If too factual → encourage story elements

consolidation.activity: Share science stories with emphasis on safety messages
consolidation.decisionPoint: If sharing time too long → limit to key elements

emergencyBackup: Collaborative class science story with everyone contributing
safetyNote: Include safety heroes and safe choices in all science stories

title: Enseigner aux autres
oneGoal: Students teach safety rules and observation skills to younger students

mindsOn.activity: Teacher role-play preparation and teaching tips
mindsOn.decisionPoint: If nervous about teaching → provide more support; If excited → practice teaching techniques

activities: Prepare safety lessons for younger students (~9 min)
Teach actual younger students or stuffed animals (~9 min)
action.decisionPoint: If teaching too advanced → simplify lessons; If effective → encourage more demonstration

consolidation.activity: Reflect on teaching experience and effective strategies
consolidation.decisionPoint: If frustrated with teaching → discuss teaching challenges

emergencyBackup: Teaching demonstration to whole class with feedback
safetyNote: Good teachers always model perfect safety for their students

title: Célébration scientifique
oneGoal: Students celebrate their growth as safe, observant young scientists

mindsOn.activity: Growth reflection with before and after comparisons
mindsOn.decisionPoint: If not seeing growth → highlight specific improvements; If proud → encourage sharing

action.decisionPoint: If overwhelmed by celebration → simplify activities; If enjoying → extend celebration time

consolidation.activity: Commitment to continue being safe scientists
consolidation.decisionPoint: If not ready to commit → discuss continued support needed

emergencyBackup: Simple celebration circle with sharing and certificates
safetyNote: Celebrate how much you've learned about being safe scientists!
